Quarterly revenue declined by 13.8% to $1.9 billion.
The company's net loss widened to $260 million.
Operating margin fell to 6.2% as manufacturing costs increased.
Weak customer demand reduced sales in the largest business segment.
Several customers delayed their planned purchases until the following year.
Operating cash flow turned negative after a substantial increase in inventories.
Management reduced its full-year earnings guidance.
Interest expense increased as the company refinanced its outstanding debt.
The business does not expect demand to recover during the next quarter.
Management warned that further losses could put pressure on available cash.
